annotations.text:
My NEPSE — seven screens.

Matched to the shipping app: Fraunces headings, IBM Plex Sans body, IBM Plex Mono for every number, and the exact nepse.css palette.

All figures are REAL and verified from the 2026-09-03 session — NEPSE 2,542.77, turnover Rs 3.47 Ar, NABIL 539.00. Only the holdings are invented, and they are marked as sample.

Every screen shows an unknown as an unknown.

Unpriced holding, unsized heatmap tile, not-evaluable alert, unknown scan result, missing open gap — each is drawn explicitly rather than as a zero. That is the product's defining behaviour, so the design has to carry it.
